subdimensions.name: Anticipatory Awareness
subdimensions.justification: Constitutional Amendment No 3 was gazetted on 16 February 2026 with no published assessment of its effects.

evidence.quote: Authorities in Zimbabwe have intensified their crackdown against critics of an effort by the ruling ZANU-PF party to push forward a constitutional amendment to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa's term of office. The government gazetted Constitutional Amendment No 3 on February 16, 2026, which would extend the term of office for both the president and parliament from five to seven years, effectively postponing the 2028 elections until 2030.

subdimensions.name: Affective Resonance
subdimensions.justification: Interactions are coercive: two students aged 23 and 21 were abducted from campus in November 2025 and found the next day, allegedly assaulted and tortured.

evidence.quote: Zimbabwean authorities have harassed, abducted, and arbitrarily detained student leaders protesting a proposed constitutional amendment to extend presidential terms.
